breaking.member: og create, CreationChoices, resolveCreationChoices and pickStyle

Only --look or explicit English/Chinese style words select a look. Input look none clears the choice; resolved choices omit look. A variant or nondefault UI pack without a look is refused rather than silently ignored. Lookless scaffolds write neither og-project.json.look nor content/looks/<id>.ts.

Display its absence as Realistic (engine default), and pass none only as a creation input, never as a look ref or preset. Do not synthesize a stylised fallback or require a style bible for lookless projects. Explicit English/Chinese style words select today's catalogue slugs; a selected preset must support the game's form/view.
